Subject: Novapulse / Redwood account overlap — quick clarification

Hi Rachel / Marissa,

Thanks again for the joint session last week. Our Post-Sales team ran the account list on our side and flagged a few named accounts that appear to be in both Novapulse and Redwood engagement plans (Arcadia Health, BlueStone Labs, and Meridian Analytics). We want to avoid duplicate outreach and keep the executive introductions clean.

I attached our internal list (redwood_novapulse_account-map_v2.xlsx) — apologies, it was an older export. Could you confirm which accounts Redwood intends to own for Q3 outreach and whether Novapulse should focus on integrations/technical value demos only for the overlaps?

High level asks:
- Quick mapping of ownership for the three overlapping accounts above
- Proposed point-of-contact per account so we can coordinate exec intros
- A mutual action plan (MAP) template we can sign off on for co-sell/exec outreach cadence

We have a tight window — our board update is May 6 and we want tidy partner motion items. Happy to hop on a short call next week.

Thanks,
Evelyn

Evelyn — thanks for the note and the attachment. I pulled the list and did a quick pass; happy to put forward a concrete proposal so we don't have conflicting outreach.

Preliminary stance (high level):
- Arcadia Health: Redwood to own exec/outreach (we have an active PoC with their ML team). Novapulse to own integration engineering introductions and value-add sessions.
- BlueStone Labs: Novapulse to lead; Redwood to be tertiary technical partner (for embedding work) unless BlueStone asks for direct sales engagement.
- Meridian Analytics: Joint engagement — split exec introductions (account team will be shared).

Next steps I propose:
1) Marissa / Sergio / Novapulse ops to finalize a MAP (I can draft the template).
2) We schedule a 30-minute alignment call Monday 4/26 9:00am PT (suggested) — Sergio, Hannah, Marissa, Evelyn + their GTM lead.
3) Finalize point-of-contact table and publish to the shared drive (linked).

I attached a starter MAP and a trimmed account map (redwood_novapulse_account-map_v3.xlsx) — note: this is a working doc.

Thanks — I copied Sergio for arbitration if we need firm territory rules.

Best,
Rachel Kim

Thanks, Rachel. Adding a few operational guardrails from the partner ops side: 

- Our rule of thumb for ISV partners vs. system integrators is (1) if Redwood has active sales motion (proposal > SOW stage), Redwood owns outreach; (2) if partner initiated technical value / integration discovery but no exec interest, partner may own initial outreach.
- For Arcadia specifically: our AE flagged a live procurement pipeline that expects pricing by 5/28 — we should own the sales lane to meet timelines.

Marissa action items (I will take):
- Update the attached MAP with milestone dates and handoff triggers (will add procurement milestone for Arcadia).
- Add Karthik as technical owner for integration scoping sessions with Novapulse.

Can we confirm Monday 4/26 9:00am PT for the alignment call (I can send the calendar invite)?

Looping in alliance stance and proposed final boundary rules so we have a clean sign-off: 

Sergio proposal (short):
- Rule A: If Redwood has an active commercial proposal (quote/SOW > draft), Redwood owns outreach.
- Rule B: If partner has established technical integration and no commercial engagement exists, partner owns initial outreach for technical enablement; Redwood technical team to support.
- Rule C: For named accounts with equal signals (both parties engaged at exec level), we default to joint outreach with a single executive owner assigned and a shared MAP.

Applying to the three names: Arcadia — Rule A (Redwood own). BlueStone — Rule B (Novapulse lead). Meridian — Rule C (joint).

I drafted a short MAP that contains: objectives, milestones, owner, communication cadence (weekly), escalation path, and a simple tiebreaker (Sergio to arbitrate). See attached: mutual-action-plan_20270425.pdf.

Please reply with one-line signoff from each organization (Redwood arr: Rachel/Marissa; Novapulse arr: Evelyn) and I'll publish final map and HubSpot ownership fields.

Sergio
Director, Alliances — Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
